prompt_text: Where is the best place to get an oil change in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you want a quick, inexpensive “fast lube,” service from your dealer (best for warranty/brand-specific needs), or a thorough check from an independent mechanic? Tell me which and I can pull up the top-rated places near you in Pleasanton.

Quick guidance now:
- Fast/convenient: Valvoline Instant Oil Change, Jiffy Lube, Firestone Complete Auto Care, or Pep Boys — they do drive-thru oil changes, often while you wait, and run online coupons.
- Dealer service: use your vehicle’s brand dealership (Honda, Toyota, Subaru, etc.) if you want dealer training, OEM parts, or to preserve warranty/maintenance records.
- Independent shop: a local ASE‑certified independent mechanic can be cheaper than the dealer and often provides a more thorough inspection and personalized service.

Price & oil type (typical):
- Conventional oil: ~$35–$60
- Full synthetic: ~$70–$150
(Prices vary by vehicle and oil type; call ahead or check online coupons.)

How to pick:
- Read recent Google/Yelp reviews for reliability and customer service.
- Verify ASE certification and shop warranty on parts/labor.
- Ask whether the quoted price includes the filter, disposal fees, and taxes.
- Keep a written invoice and ask them to show the old filter/oil if you want proof.
- Check for coupons, AAA discounts, or first-time customer offers.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code or the part of Pleasanton you’re in and whether you prefer fast vs. thorough/cheap vs. dealer — I’ll look up the top-rated options, addresses, hours, and current coupons.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
